task: ai-bookkeeper flagship, buildable item (5): score the cash-line guess rule on CORD validation photos

errors.what: A backgrounded apt-get subshell raced the cd into the scratch folder, so the pyarrow venv and two 240 MB CORD parquets landed in ventures/ai-bookkeeper; moved out before any commit.

doc_friction.issue: The cash rule was written from a text description of validation-30; on the photos it broke validation-66 (exact cash, one item). A rule written without its own data should be flagged as unmeasured in the flagship row, which it was, so the next run knew to score it.
--misses lists total misses only, so tax swaps between versions are visible only through counts; a per-receipt tax diff would have been quicker.

notes: CORD photos re-read via CLI --four-pass reproduced the last run (val 64/98, test 53/95). Main's cash rule fixed val-30, broke val-66 (net 0). Added: exact cash keeps its vote when the amount is printed off the cash line (val totals 64->65); tax ties broken by readings printing the amount on a tax line (val tax 22->23, wrong 4->3). Test scored once at the end: no receipt moved. SRD CLI re-read: 153 totals, tax 134/12/39, identical misses before and after. Full venture suite: 2727 pass, 0 fail. Both new tests fail on main's receipts.mjs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: re-running OCR on 400 photos, diagnosing two receipts, two vote rules with tests and a write-up

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
